UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile and alert notification preferences.

uid.description: Firebase Auth user UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name shown in the navigation account badge.

avatarUrl.description: Optional HTTPS image URL or compressed 128x128 WebP/JPEG/PNG data URI.

browserEnabled.description: Whether browser push popups are enabled.

soundEnabled.description: Whether notification chime audio is enabled.

notifyPlaced.description: Whether demon placement alerts are enabled.

notifyUpdated.description: Whether demon rank/requirement update alerts are enabled.

notifyTop10Victor.description: Whether Top 10 victor alerts are enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile and cloud-synced alert preferences.
